description: This file is a TypeScript source code for importing Notion data into a board/archive format, involving CSV parsing, file system operations, and creating board and card objects.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates reading CSV, converting data, and saving archive.

methods.name: getCsvFilePath
methods.description: Finds the CSV file in the specified input folder.

methods.name: getMarkdown
methods.description: Retrieves markdown content for a given card title from markdown folder.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Extracts column headers from CSV input data.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts CSV input data into board and block objects for archive.
